entries.title: Report content for review
entries.description: You can report posts, threads, comments, profiles, and communities. Notices explain when content is hidden while reports are reviewed.

entries.title: Find people by name
entries.description: You can search for people by username or name from the home page.

entries.title: Feeds check for new posts
entries.description: Your feeds now check for new posts while you browse, so you can keep up without refreshing the page yourself.

entries.title: Search from page headers
entries.description: You can use search dropdowns on Home, Explore, Library, and Notifications to find people, communities, titles, and notifications.

entries.title: Keep track of your invite links
entries.description: You can see your active community invites and revoke links you no longer want to share. Invite pages also show more of the community’s appearance.

entries.title: Learn more before joining a community
entries.description: You can read community descriptions and hover over community cards to see member previews and mutual friends.

entries.title: Clearer updates on your feedback
entries.description: You’ll see report statuses such as Received, Being worked on, and Fixed, plus a message from the team when one is added to your resolved report.

entries.title: Mark notifications read in one place
entries.description: You can mark all notifications as read from the unread notifications bar.

entries.title: Preview Orbis before signing up
entries.description: You can discover featured communities on the refreshed welcome page, with updated sign-in screens and navigation.
